gloss: across the board; all in a row; without exception

definitions.gloss: row of houses; house after house
definitions.explanation: A line of buildings standing side by side along a street.

definitions.gloss: across the board; without exception; one after another
definitions.explanation: Used adverbially to indicate that something applies to every case in a group, without exception. Very common in news and business reporting.

examples.japanese: {商店|しょうてん}の{軒並|のきな}みがきれいに{並|なら}んでいる。
examples.english: The row of shops is neatly lined up.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}で{軒並|のきな}み{屋根|やね}が{飛|と}ばされた。
examples.english: The typhoon blew off the roofs of house after house.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{軒並|のきな}みが{残|のこ}る{通|とお}りを{散歩|さんぽ}した。
examples.english: I strolled along a street where old rows of houses still remain.

examples.japanese: {株価|かぶか}が{軒並|のきな}み{下落|げらく}した。
examples.english: Stock prices fell across the board.

examples.japanese: {飲食店|いんしょくてん}が{軒並|のきな}み{値上|ねあ}げした。
examples.english: Restaurants raised prices across the board.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}の{入試|にゅうし}は{難|むずか}しく、{受験者|じゅけんしゃ}の{点数|てんすう}が{軒並|のきな}み{低|ひく}かった。
examples.english: This year's entrance exams were difficult, and examinees' scores were low across the board.

notes:
Compound of {軒|のき} (eaves, house) + {並|な}み (row, line). Originally described a row of houses, but the adverbial sense 2 is now more common.

As an adverb, {軒並|のきな}み emphasizes that something affects every member of a group uniformly. It is especially frequent in news reporting about market trends, price changes, and widespread phenomena.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {軒並|のきな}み{上昇|じょうしょう} (rise across the board)
- {軒並|のきな}み{下落|げらく} (fall across the board)
- {軒並|のきな}み{値上|ねあ}げ (price hikes across the board)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一様|いちよう}に: uniformly (more formal)
- {一斉|いっせい}に: all at once (emphasizes simultaneity)
- どれも: all of them (colloquial, less emphatic)
